comments.comment: Love thissssss. And providing links?! Yasssss. Raw and real. Truth

Here's a perspective from someone who would give up a child for adoption. I was raised Catholic and taught that abortion is basically the worst thing you could do. I have also had an extreme fear of pregnancy and childbirth since I was a child myself. Even though I am no longer Catholic and am pro choice, the Catholicism still lives within me, and I don't think I could live with myself if I got one. I also know raising a child would take a huge psychological toll on me and seeing that child would remind me of the horrors I endured to bring them into the world because my Catholic guilt would not allow me to terminate the pregnancy. (In short, let's pray I'm infertile)
